summary_md: This looks high-impact (auth/payments/sends/migrations). The lane planned it but paused for your go before doing anything. Plan: ## Plan for ARCA-61 — Saved watchlists not persisting across login  ### What I found before proposing anything (read-only)  I traced the full chain: `WatchlistPage.tsx` → `client/src/lib/api.ts` → `modules/watchlist/handlers.ts` auth middleware → `db/auth.ts` (`getSession`) → `modules/watchlist/schema.ts`.  As currently written, this chain looks **correctly scoped**: - Every watchlist route requires a valid session cookie and filters strictly by `eq(watchlists.user_id, userId)` — no anonymous/guest fallback, no hardcoded default watchlist. - The client sets `credentials: "include"`
